sql:
-- First, let's get all order-product combinations with their total required quantities
SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, p.name as product_name, SUM(ol.qty) as required_qty
FROM orderlines ol
JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY p.name, ol.order_id

-- For each order-product, get inventory rows sorted by purchased ASC, qty ASC

WITH order_products AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, p.name as product_name, SUM(ol.qty) as required_qty
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id

),

    SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty, pu.purchased,

    FROM inventory i

),
-- For each order-product, join with inventory and calculate cumulative

    SELECT op.order_id, op.product_id, op.product_name, op.required_qty,

)
